# mock-outputs

Placeholder artifacts that the mock provider serves (D-14). They are generated by
`scripts/make-tiny-session.ts` together with `../tiny-session/`. They are structurally valid,
but they are not a reconstruction.

- `splat.ply`: 8 gaussians (binary little-endian 3DGS PLY) at the first camera centres.
- `collider.ply`: an ASCII unit box (8 vertices, 12 triangles), standing in for `mesh-simplified`.
- `floorplan.png` + `floorplan.json`: a 64x64 white image and an Echo-3 floorplan meta block
  (`spaitial-world-v1`, 0.05 m/px).
- `cameras.json`: `spaitial.capture_cameras.v1`, where `camera_from_splat = arkitToOpenCV(T_arkit)`
  for each fixture frame.
- `thumbnail.jpg`: a copy of `../demo-room/thumbnail.jpg`, so the default set also gives Library rows an image.
